title: Oct 13 Results + Oct 14 Preview: When Your Only Pick Crashes and Burns
summary: Oct 13: 0-1, zero wins. Let me be honest—that was embarrassing.

content.value:
## Let Me Be Honest: That Was Brutal

One pick. ONE. And we missed it. The Guardians were supposed to show up against the Rays with 50% confidence, and instead they decided to play like they forgot baseball was a competitive sport. When you go 0-for-1, there's nowhere to hide. No silver linings, no moral victories. Just pure, unfiltered failure.

## The Guardians Let Us Down

Here's the thing about 50% confidence picks—they're basically a coin flip. But when that coin lands on tails and you're sitting there with egg on your face, it stings twice as much. Cleveland had every opportunity to make this right, and they folded. That's baseball, baby. Cruel, unforgiving, and ready to humble you at every turn.

But you know what? We dust off and move forward. Because tomorrow is a new day, and tomorrow we've got something spicy brewing in Los Angeles.

## Oct 14 Preview: Redemption in Chavez Ravine

Forget yesterday. Tomorrow we're backing the Dodgers at home against Milwaukee with 57% confidence. Blake Snell on the mound for LA, Robert Gasser trying to keep the Brewers competitive. This isn't rocket science—Snell at Dodger Stadium is money, and the Brewers are walking into a buzzsaw.

content.title: ⭐ Oct 14 Top Pick
content.sub: 57% win probability · Blake Snell vs Robert Gasser · Home advantage

content.value:
## Why the Dodgers Will Bounce Us Back

Let me tell you why this pick is different from yesterday's disaster. Blake Snell isn't some middle-of-the-rotation arm—he's a difference-maker when he's locked in. Robert Gasser? He's got potential, but this isn't the spot where potential beats pedigree. 

The Dodgers at home, in October, with their backs potentially against the wall? That's a recipe for dominance. Milwaukee has been scrappy all year, but scrappy doesn't cut it when you're facing an elite pitcher in a hostile environment.

57% confidence might not sound sexy, but it's honest. It's realistic. And after going 0-1 yesterday with a 50-50 toss-up, I'll take the slight edge with the better team every single time.

## The Bottom Line

Oct 13 was a disaster. No sugarcoating it. But Oct 14 is about redemption. The Dodgers are our path back to respectability, and Blake Snell is the arm we're riding. 

See you tomorrow when we're back in the win column.

— Rico
